description: This Java class 'JavaEventHandler' handles web events by dynamically loading classes and invoking specified methods, managing transactions, and logging errors and verbose information.

classes.name: JavaEventHandler
classes.description: A static method Java event handler that loads classes dynamically, invokes methods, and manages transactions for web events.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by name using the current thread's context class loader, returns null if not found.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler; currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles an event by loading the class, invoking the specified method with request and response, managing transaction boundaries, and error handling.
